analysis.repeated_attack_signal: the same secret-attack model exceeds |t|=4.5 at sample indices within three samples in both independent campaigns
analysis.repeated_tvla_signal: first- or centered-square second-order TVLA exceeds |t|=4.5 at sample indices within three samples, or cross-time centered-product second-order TVLA exceeds it at pairs whose two coordinates are each within three samples, in both primary campaigns
analysis.negative_control: fixed_vs_fixed_control attack-model correlations, pointwise and cross-time TVLA, and every permuted null-model correlation remain below threshold; failure makes the campaign inconclusive and never rejects the primitive
analysis.raw_separation: all six reports, campaign identifiers and raw-trace hashes must be distinct while the UF2 hash remains identical

scope: Preregistered two-campaign comparison only. Reproducible positive evidence rejects the exact primitive. Complete negative evidence remains bounded to that function/build and cannot approve masked multiplication, Montgomery arithmetic, Cornacchia, Sign or SQIsign.
